name: Aero Commander 500/700 Shrike
summary: Big, roomy high-wing piston twin built from the 1950s to 1986, widely used as an executive and utility aircraft; its family also includes the turboprop Turbo Commanders.

wings: High-set wing above a deep, wide fuselage
Engine nacelles blend into the leading edge
engines: Long nacelles extending well behind the wing
Main gear retracts into the nacelles
fuselage: Deep, wide cabin with a blunt rounded nose
tail: Tall, sharply swept fin with a squared top

tellTales: High wing on a deep fuselage with long nacelles slung beneath it
Blunt rounded nose with a large windshield

confusedWith.howToTell: The 690 has turboprop engines with slim turbine cowls, spinners and exhaust stubs; the piston Commander has blunter piston cowlings.
The Queen Air is a low-wing aircraft; the Commander's wing is set high on the fuselage.
The King Air has a low wing, turboprop nacelles with exhaust stacks and often a T-tail; the Commander has a high wing and piston cowlings.
